Incoming calls

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

The incoming call screen has the Answer and Reject buttons.

Send Message rejects the call and sends a ready-made message. You edit these messages in the Quick Replies section of Settings.

Remind Me reminds you about the call after the number of minutes you choose.

If a second call comes in during a call, you are asked what to do: Hold and accept or End and accept.

You can silence the ringer with a volume key. With Turn Over to Silence on, turning the phone face down also silences the ringer and the caller announcement; the call keeps ringing silently and you can still answer it.

With Raise to Answer on, raising the phone to your ear silences the ringer, and the call is answered when the phone’s sensor detects your ear.

With Auto Answer on, the call is answered by itself after the time set in Wait Before Answering. With Only with a Headset, calls are not answered by themselves unless a wired headset or Bluetooth device is connected; with Only Saved Contacts, calls from numbers not in your contacts are not. A call whose ringer you silenced is not answered by itself either.

These three settings are at the end of the Accessibility section of Settings. Full screen incoming call screen is in the same section; when it is off, an incoming call appears only as a notification.
